name: Weather
summary: Current weather and a short forecast for any place, from Open-Meteo. No account needed.

tools.name: weather.now
tools.description: Gets the current weather (temperature, conditions, wind, humidity) for a city or place name.

place.description: City or place, for example Lagos or Paris

tools.name: weather.forecast
tools.description: Gets the daily forecast (highs, lows, chance of rain) for a city or place name for the next 1 to 7 days.
